verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਈ।
verses.translit_en: pooraa satigur aap na alakh lakhaaviee|

en.bdb: Lord Himself is the true Guru who is imperceptible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhekhai thaap uthaap jiau tis bhaaviee|

en.bdb: Of His own will He Establishes or uproots.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਈ।
verses.translit_en: lep na pu(n)n na paap upai samaaviee|

en.bdb: The sin and virtue of creation and destruction do not touch Him at all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਗੂ ਵਰੁ ਨ ਸਰਾਪ ਨ ਆਪ ਜਣਾਵਈ।
verses.translit_en: lagoo var na saraap na aap janaaviee|

en.bdb: He never makes anybody notice Him and boons and curses do not stick to Him.
The true Guru recites the Word and unfolds the grandeur of that indescribable Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਨ ਜਗਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਈ।
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa jap jaap na jagat kamaaviee|

en.bdb: Eulogosong the ineffable (Lord) he does not indulge in hypocrisy and guile.
The effulgence of the perfect Guru finishes off the ego of the seekers of knowledge.
The Guru effacing the three suferings (god-sent, physical and spiritual) lessens the anxieties of the people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit_en: gurbaanee man dhraap nij ghar aaviee ||7||

en.bdb: Getting satiated by the teachings of such a Guru, the individual stays in his innate nature.
